candidates.description:
DC215
Legacy software: the stuff nobody wants to touch and everybody still depends on. Join DC215's AppSec Village session as Ag digs into how he cracked some legacy business software, and why that matters for anyone defending real-world systems. We will will discuss the steps and techniques used to collect details from the database, web proxy interceptions, and .NET disassembly and how to put it all together to fully subvert the licensing system. We'll go light on details about tool usage and focus more on the overarching process.
